_comment: Local gateway settings. Set a real 'token' before exposing this off loopback — one is minted and persisted back into this file if left empty. 'gateway_id' is this gateway's identity: it is what a client compares against /healthz to prove it reached THIS gateway and not another one that happens to answer on the same port, and it is also the federation-chain cycle check. Minted and persisted here on first use, same as 'token' — pin it explicitly only if a deployment needs a chosen value. 'max_federation_depth' caps how many gateway-upstream hops deep a tools/list can aggregate through before a federation is refused.
